extends Node
var p
var accepted_count := 0
func _ready() -> void:
	p = get_meta("viento_project")
	set_process(false)
	set_physics_process(false)
	call_deferred("_start")
func _start() -> void:
	var host = p.host.get_ref()
	host.set_process(false)
	_accepted("first-stop", p.stop_audio("77777777-7777-4777-8777-000000000001"))
	host.flush_requests()
	_applied("first-stop")
	_accepted("unavailable-play", p.play_audio("77777777-7777-4777-8777-000000000001"))
	_accepted("later-stop", p.stop_audio("77777777-7777-4777-8777-000000000001"))
	_accepted("later-play", p.play_audio("77777777-7777-4777-8777-000000000001"))
	# Fault injection matches the existing audio control native fixture.
	host.current.audio_started = false
	host.flush_requests()
	_applied("failed-backend-call")
func _probe(kind: String, label: String, extra: Dictionary = {}) -> void:
	var data := {"kind": kind, "label": label, "clock": {"idleFrame": Engine.get_process_frames(), "physicsFrame": Engine.get_physics_frames()}}
	data.merge(extra)
	print("VIENTO_AUDIO_REQUEST_PROBE:" + JSON.stringify(data))
func _accepted(label: String, accepted: bool) -> void:
	if accepted:
		accepted_count += 1
	_probe("accepted", label, {"accepted": accepted, "requestId": accepted_count if accepted else null, "reserved": p.host.get_ref().audio_control.reserved_count})
func _applied(label: String) -> void:
	_probe("applied", label, {"commandSequence": p.host.get_ref().audio_control.sequence})
func _finish() -> void:
	p.host.get_ref().finish_project()
